units.content: Primary prediction requires measurable increase in aligned information velocity before accessibility acceleration and capability growth within a pre-specified bounded horizon τ.
Framework remains an empirical hypothesis requiring historical datasets, proxy reconstruction and falsification testing.
Operational accessibility estimate uses D_R, T_M, E_A and P_A and aims to estimate changes over time rather than direct accessibility.
Exponential functional form is explicitly described as an initial operational model; alternative functional forms may be evaluated during empirical validation.

Historical variables are not directly observable; uncertainties include mutual information reconstruction, structural-vs-accumulated knowledge, resource-scaling separation and implicit utility alignment.

Specifies temporal validation steps and five rejection conditions including ordering failure, resource explanation, absent description-length prediction, false-positive dominance and post-hoc horizon adjustment.
Causal variables, measurable proxies, validation protocol and falsification criteria are currently defined.
Remaining empirical work: construct historical datasets, estimate Λ_E trajectories, compare precursor signals with transitions and evaluate predictive performance.
Survival requires precursor ordering, bounded lead time, resource-control survival, manageable false positives and cross-domain signal.
Source reiterates capability explosions as downstream consequences of earlier exploration-efficiency transformations and says contrary empirical evidence should reject framework.
Specifies hardware, dataset and algorithmic alternatives/controls and six conditions that would weaken the autodiff case.
Classifies autodiff as candidate χ_g structural transition and says historical reconstruction of timing, throughput, description length and resource-normalized information velocity remains required.
Reports observed binary-classification agreement of 80–85% against common historical interpretations.
Source says a Cohen's-kappa-style estimate would likely fall in substantial-to-almost-perfect range; no actual kappa computation is reported.
Lists consciousness-without-integration, integration-without-consciousness and intelligence-without-self-integration as weakening conditions.
Presents Causal Mass -> Interface-Induced Computational Geometry -> Computational Phase Boundaries -> consciousness as a source-described conceptual chain; endpoints remain unresolved at map level.
States purpose is not to declare consciousness solved but to define a falsifiable computational hypothesis and requires measurable predictive architectural conditions.

units.section: 5. Compression Is Necessary but Not Sufficient
units.content: Beautiful conceptual compression does not guarantee increased information velocity or search capability; successful theory-to-tool transition requires an interface that improves search.
Source says strongest demonstrated capability of CPB is currently reframing/navigation rather than prediction and describes it as a search heuristic for exploration bottlenecks.
External transfer should enable unfamiliar users/systems to identify bottlenecks, generate interventions, recognize boundaries and outperform conventional approaches.
Current synthesis: a phase boundary occurs when a system transforms the mechanism by which it explores possibility space.
Can CPB itself become a phase boundary by moving from framework describing exploration to interface improving exploration?
Proposes shared trajectory-based abstraction across computational systems, cognition, music organization and technological evolution.
Elegant explanations and analogies without better predictions, decisions or exploration are insufficient; compression must increase search velocity to count as useful interface.
Proposes operational tests for bottleneck identification, intervention generation, human/AI reasoning-loop improvement and prediction against simpler models.
Concludes computational progress occurs when systems improve mechanisms by which they improve, and a descriptive framework becomes exemplary only if it changes search process.
Proposes authenticity proportional to negative divergence between internal and behavioral distributions and explicitly says this is a proposed formalization, not established measurement.
Can authenticity-related signals predict long-term behavior better than surface behavior alone?
Proposes authenticity as coherence between a trajectory-generating system and the measurable trajectory observers see.
